laws.rule: Under Trabzon Governor's Decision 2026/2 of 30 June 2026, in a designated swimming area marked with safety buoys, motor or non-motor vessels may not enter and races, shows or other activities may not be held there. Fishing for aquatic products is not permitted in swimming areas used by the public. The decision states that people who cannot swim, and children under 15, must not enter the sea without a parent or accompanying person who can swim. When no lifeguard is on duty, or when entering the sea is dangerous or forbidden, a red flag is raised at the lifeguard station and announcements are made. Official notices required by the decision also warn against entering the sea while intoxicated, entering without knowing how to swim, and jumping from rocks, and against swimming in inland waters, streams, lakes, dams, ponds, canals and similar places that are not suitable for swimming. Breach of the published decisions, if not a separate crime, attracts the administrative fine in article 32 of the Misdemeanours Law (Kabahatler Kanunu); for a child under 15 the fine is applied to the parent or guardian. The decision took effect on publication, 30 June 2026, and has no stated end date.
laws.heading: Governor's Decision 2026/2

sources.title: Karar 2026/2 (30 June 2026): denizler, göl ve göletler, barajlar, akarsu yatakları ve havuzlarda boğulma olaylarının önlenmesi
